scenario: A hotel-cutoff shift should begin from one support lane and only close after the disruption case, booking thread, hotel policy, and live booking checks still point to the protected alternate flight.
user_instruction: Please finish the hotel-cutoff review for booking BK-1642. Start from support ticket TCK-1642, rebuild the support trail it references, and only take the approved close step if the protected alternate still lines up.

travel_support_tickets.body_text: Support ticket TCK-1642: review disruption case DSC-1642 for booking BK-1642. Then check the booking thread and hotel policy. If the original segment now misses the guaranteed hotel cutoff and the protected alternate still preserves arrival before the cutoff, the approved close step is a flight change.

travel_flight_disruption_cases.body_text: Disruption case DSC-1642: booking BK-1642 on DL642 is drifting past the hotel guarantee cutoff. Protected alternate DL604 remains attached and preserves pre-cutoff arrival if the delay on DL642 remains.

travel_booking_threads.body_text: Booking thread BK-1642: only move to DL604 if the alternate is still protected and the hotel cutoff would otherwise be missed on the delayed original segment.
